name: pr-1863
title: PR — #1863: the conic chip (focus and directrix) and the ellipse that is a circle

cases.title: A parabola's chip shows the directrix, then the focus, then both, with their values
cases.lookFor: The row carries a chip «הצג מדריך». Press 1: a thin dashed line x = -27/2 appears, chip «הצג מוקד». Press 2: the line goes and a blue dot F(27/2, 0) appears, chip «הצג מוקד ומדריך». Press 3: both are drawn, chip «הסתר».
cases.before: Prod draws no focus and no directrix, and there is no chip.

cases.title: The fourth press returns the parabola to nothing
cases.lookFor: After the fourth press «הסתר» the figure is the bare parabola again and the chip reads «הצג מדריך».

cases.title: An ellipse's chip shows both foci and both directrices
cases.lookFor: Press 1: two dashed lines x = 25/4 and x = -25/4. Press 2: two blue dots F₁(4, 0) and F₂(-4, 0), lines gone. Press 3: all four, chip «הסתר».
cases.before: Prod draws no foci and no directrices; the ellipse's directrices are computed nowhere.

cases.title: A parabola with a parameter shows the marks without values
cases.lookFor: The focus dot is labelled F alone (no coordinates) and the dashed directrix has no equation, because p is not given.

cases.title: An ellipse with equal axes is a circle: no chip, its centre marked, the panel lists the centre, and a notice
expect: האליפסה היא כעת מעגל — מעגל הוא סוג של אליפסה
cases.lookFor: No chip on the row. The circle's centre cross at the origin, labelled (0, 0). The data panel's row reads «מרכז: (0, 0)», not «מוקדים». Notice: «בגלל הנתון נתונה אליפסה שמשוואתה x^2/9+y^2/9=1, האליפסה היא כעת מעגל — מעגל הוא סוג של אליפסה.»
cases.before: Prod draws the round curve with no centre mark and no notice, and the panel lists «מוקדים: (0, 0), (0, 0)».

cases.title: A later given that makes the ellipse round is named in the notice
cases.lookFor: After «a=3» the chip leaves the ellipse's row and the notice names «a=3» as the cause.

cases.title: A student's own F elsewhere: the focus mark drops the letter and keeps its coordinates
cases.lookFor: The student's F(1,1) stays F. The focus dot at (2, 0) is labelled (2, 0) with no letter.

cases.title: Undo takes back a chip press
cases.lookFor: After «בטל» the directrix is gone, the chip reads «הצג מדריך» again, and the parabola's row is still there.

cases.title: «הציגו תצורה אחרת» keeps the chip's state
cases.lookFor: Another configuration redraws the parabola wider or narrower; the focus dot and the dashed directrix move with it and the chip still reads «הסתר».

cases.title: A circle gets no focus chip
cases.lookFor: The circle draws as before, with its centre O; no chip on its row. (Next line to try: «נתונה פרבולה שמשוואתה y^2=8x» — its row gets «הצג מדריך».)

cases.title: The centre of an ellipse with equal axes is clickable, as a circle's centre is

after.say: לחצו על סימון המרכז בראשית הצירים

cases.lookFor: The centre has the dashed offer ring a circle's centre has. Clicking it opens the letter box; typing K records the row «K מרכז האליפסה» and the point K sits at the origin.
cases.before: Prod draws no centre and nothing to click.
